Moreover, hippocampal glutamatergic neurons have unique cellular properties, including higher excitability (lower firing threshold) (Marin-Burgin et al., 2012), to optimize hippocampal functions such as learning and memory (Tamminga et al., 2010).
252086716_f9c70b51.section: Major Glutamatergic Cell Types in Hippocampal Subfields

252086716_9d46d627.text: Glutamatergic neurons dominate the hippocampal architecture, accounting for over 90% of all hippocampal neurons, with pyramidal layers being densely packed with these excitatory cells (Mancini et al., 2022).
